summary.description: Summarize this text. Text: NEAR accounts have human-readable names such as alice.near. One account can hold several access keys. A full-access key can do anything the account can. A function-call key can only call the methods it lists on one contract, cannot attach a deposit, and can carry a gas allowance. Sub-accounts such as bot.alice.near can only be created by alice.near.

audit.description: Audit this NEAR contract method for security risk and give one fix per risk. Rust: pub fn withdraw(&mut self, amount: U128) -> Promise { let who = env::predecessor_account_id(); Promise::new(who).transfer(NearToken::from_yoctonear(amount.0)).then(Self::ext(env::current_account_id()).on_withdraw()) } The balance map is updated in on_withdraw.
